facts.text: The user’s team decided to do a daily prompt sharing challenge to learn ChatGPT.
The user asked for expertise such as behavioral psychology to suggest how the challenge can help people study a lot and have a system to help each other.
The user said the content was too long and asked to organize it easily and concisely enough for a 5th grade elementary school level.
The user asked which single way would be good for motivating and sustaining the challenge.
The user’s team is considering giving each other a penalty to buy coffee to continue the challenge.
The user asked about giving tacos as a positive reinforcement in an appreciation system for the team.
The user asked who should receive positive reinforcement: anyone who did the challenge unconditionally or the person who shared the most effective content.
